text:
Zara: Quick heads-up — MerchantCo wants a 5-day POC for their custom model 'NebulaEdge-28B' (customer-supplied). They want fp16 + q4_0 variants, Dedicated with VPC peering, and routing tests between Hosted and Dedicated. Need tokenizer check, KV/cache layout compatibility, and a licensing confirmation.

Owen: Repo/manifest?

Zara: Link in ticket: https://git.example/merchantco/nebularedge tag v2.0. Tokenizer is HF BPE but uses a custom post-processor. Model is 28B with an added classification head and grouped attention (groups=2). They say "commercial ok" in intake but license file is unclear.

Felix: Running quick probe — tokenizer sanity + forward smoke on our shim. Commands:

``
 git clone https://git.example/merchantco/nebularedge /tmp/nebularedge
 python tools/check_tokenizer.py --path /tmp/nebularedge --prompt "Test"
 python tools/runtime_probe.py --model /tmp/nebularedge --dtype fp16 --seq 384 --batch 1
```

infra-bot: ticket MC-4210 created: "NebulaEdge-28B presales compatibility" assigned to @owen, watchers: @felix, @nadia, @zara.

Owen: Tokenizer loads but post-processor strips control tokens — added a small mapping to preserve special tokens. Forward failed: KV layout uses grouped-heads layout (num_groups, seq, heads_per_group, head_dim). Our runtime expects (num_heads, seq, head_dim). We can reshape but need to ensure group semantics preserved for rotary/ALiBi.

Nadia: For Dedicated sizing: FP16 path -> 2xA100-80GB (baseline). If they want low-latency 3xH100. q4_0 might fit on 2xA100 with sharding but needs validation. Ballpark infra for 5d POC at 80k tokens/day: ~$3.9k + SE time for adapter + quant.

Felix: Opening a small runtime adapter PR to flatten grouped heads into num_heads while recording group metadata so attention math stays identical. Also added tokenizer postproc hook. PR: https://git.internal/pr/6021

Owen: After adapter applied, fp16 smoke runs succeeded on short eval. Next: run classification head inference and ensure logits align. Also start q4_0 pipeline.

Nadia: Security/legal: LICENSE.txt says "research-only". That's a blocker for hosted. Asked MerchantCo to provide a commercial POC license or a hosting waiver. Also requested SOC2 summary and peering CIDRs. If they can't, offer on-prem POC with our SEs.

Zara: Can we run a short quant test in staging while license pending (internal-only)? If quality holds, we'll prep cost sheets. Also they asked about routing test — can we route some traffic to Hosted fallback if Dedicated has capacity issues?

Felix: Routing yes — we can simulate traffic split policy. For the POC, propose a canary: 80% Dedicated, 20% Hosted variant (if hosting allowed). Need product config set by infra.

Nadia: MerchantCo legal replied: willing to sign a one-week hosting addendum for the POC but require IP protection clause. Legal reviewing. Licensing no longer hard-blocked pending signed addendum.

Owen: q4_0 run completed on small eval. Metrics: median perplexity delta vs fp16 ~2.2%, top-k overlap 93%. Classification head top-1 agreement 91% on smoke set. Sharing full CSV in ticket.

Nadia: Drafted SQA answers and peering checklist. Will need MerchantCo to confirm CIDR and a point-of-contact for firewall exceptions.

Zara: Action items: Owen -> full eval and classification head parity run; Felix -> finalize adapter + smoke logs; Nadia -> close hosting addendum; I'll coordinate with customer for peering info. Target readiness update tomorrow 10:30 PT. :calendar:
